Hi,

I'm sorry but I came across another problem while trying to figure out my previous problem (see "Usage input not available for polygon detectors" conversation). So, I think I figured out how to enter my own habitat masks without getting secr to automatically generate habitat masks for my sessions (I have posted what I did in the previous conversation).

However, when I try to run secr.fit(), I get the error:

So, I went to individually check each of my detector trap layouts with the verify() function and I found that of the 12 trap dataframes, only the fifth one checks out with no errors. Every other trap dataframe has the error:

Search areas overlap, or no search area specified

I have gone through the format of each of the trap dataframes and I couldn't find anything wrong. I have attached the .txt files of all my trap dataframes and the code of how I entered them into R. I would really appreciate any help/advice you guys can offer.


Cheers,
